questions.question: A father said a young man followed a woman like an ox going to slaughter. What does this picture show about him?

answers.text: He's being chased by a hunter
He's strong enough to break free

questions.question: A father warned his sons about a dangerous woman. What did he tell them to do about her?

answers.text: Don't let your heart turn aside to her ways
Talk with her and turn her back
Stay off her paths only at night

questions.question: In a father's warning, the woman who meets a young man tells him that her husband is at home. True or false?
At the end of a father's warning about a dangerous woman, where did he say her house leads?

answers.text: Down to the chambers of death
Out to a house of feasting
Up to the halls of honor
